entry_mechanic_exact.note: The two assets in this family carry only 'LEARN MORE' as a call to action. The 'Scan In Members App. / To Redeem 10 Entries!' mechanic belongs to the QR-panel card backs (Mustang and Euro Summer families) — do NOT borrow it here. A planner that transplants it is describing a different campaign.

raffle_id.note: 'Raffle ID: G2T6A03' is recorded for the QR-panel backs and is itself flagged as a placeholder (RAFFLE_ID env). Not evidenced for this family. Source: Brand Context/Muha_Meds.md:240,299

assets._ocr_note: sieve-ocr at confidence >=0.9. '$25.000+' is the OCR read; the rendered glyph is a comma. OCR output is what a machine SEES — never treat it as design intent.

third_party_marks.consequence: Prominent rendered branded product fails moderation. Expect OutputVideoSensitiveContentDetected.PolicyViolation on close framing.

never_use_for: reference_image on a generation — a tightly-cropped third-party mark is refused
any 9:16 deliverable without accepting that a 1:1 source loses ~44% of its pixels to letterbox
